description: This file defines various collection converter classes in Java, including converters between arrays, lists, maps, sets, and strings, used within the Apache OFBiz framework for type conversion operations.

classes.name: CollectionConverters
classes.description: Main class providing multiple inner classes for converting between different collection types and other representations.

classes.name: ArrayCreator
classes.description: Creates converters from array classes to List.

classes.name: ArrayClassToList
classes.description: Converts array objects to List objects.

classes.name: MapToList
classes.description: Converts Map to List containing the Map.

classes.name: MapToSet
classes.description: Converts Map to Set containing the Map.

classes.name: StringToList
classes.description: Converts String to List, with special handling for string representations of lists.

classes.name: StringToMap
classes.description: Converts String to Map, expecting a specific formatting.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads and registers the contained converters for the collection conversions.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates a converter between specified source and target classes.

methods.name: canConvert
methods.description: Checks if the conversion between source and target classes is supported.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs the actual conversion of objects.
